statement: 跨仓库 Intake 不应只上传‘CI failed’。源仓库最接近运行现场，应先捕获 workflow/job/step 等低层证据；Foundry 再做确定性分类、关联历史知识和人工复核，从而避免中央系统依赖跨仓库日志权限或凭 workflow 名猜测根因。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.INTAKE.SOURCE_ENRICHED_TRIAGE; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
